title: Personalise the App
description: Add a 'userName' property and display it with a custom greeting.
problemStatement:
The AppComponent currently only shows a static `title`. Let’s make it more personal. 1. Open `app.component.ts` and add a new property called `userName` with a value of your name. 2. Modify `app.component.html` to display a personalised greeting, for example: `

Welcome, {{ userName }}!

`. 3. Save and check that the greeting appears correctly in the browser.
hints: Add the property inside the AppComponent class: `userName = 'Alex';`
Use double curly braces in the template to display it.
expectedOutput: The browser should show a welcome message that includes your name, e.g., 'Welcome, Alex!'
